Subject: SIG questionnaire & evidence request (Riverbank)

Hi Ava,

Thanks for taking this—Riverbank's security team is running a SIG assessment as part of our diligence for the potential platform purchase. We've attached our SIG template (Riverbank_SIG_Template_v2.xlsx) and highlighted roughly 45 controls we need substantiation for. For this intake we need:

- A control mapping (SIG IDs to Redwood controls / references)
- Evidence artifacts for key controls: key rotation logs, KMS policy, key inventory export, SOC 2 Type II excerpt or the relevant control narratives, architecture diagram showing tenant isolation and network boundaries, and recent penetration test summary if available.
- A single CSV index of artifacts (filename, control id, owner, last-modified)

Timeline: Can you commit to an initial control-map (spreadsheet) within 48 hours and a first evidence packet within 5 business days? We will accept a secure Drive link or SFTP. If any controls require redaction, flag them and we'll work with legal.

Attached: Riverbank_SIG_Template_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

Cheers,
Jared
